resources.string: What the app tells the AI for each job it does. The job, page or resume and the answer’s format are added by the app and stay fixed.
The AI instructions could not be loaded.
General rules for every check. Your own wishes go in What to filter out.
Finds the jobs on a search page of a site the app has no built-in reader for.
Copies a job’s description from its page on such a site.
Scores your resume against each job and suggests fixes.
Decides whether a job on the company’s own careers site is the board’s job when the titles differ.
Writes exact before and after changes that fit your resume to one job, from its ATS review. Used when you choose Improve my resume for this job.
Writes tips for negotiating a job’s offer from its pay data, reviews, age and ATS match.

You can always come back with Reset to default.
The instructions are empty. The AI then gets only the job and the answer format, and its answers will be poor.
These words are gone: %1$s. The answer has a field for each, and without them the AI may leave it empty.
The text talks about the answer’s format (JSON and the like). The app fixes the format itself; a different one asked here can confuse the AI.
These instructions read job boards. If the AI misreads pages, jobs from those sites may stop coming in.
Results will differ from before for new jobs.
